0.why: Sjip.cpp:66 reads this input with getVoltage, which is channel 0 only; Sjip.cpp:67 clamps the knob-plus-input sum to -4 to 6, so a negative voltage lowers the pitch

comment: The harmonic levels at Sjip.cpp:152 and :153 are the Bessel J1 coefficients listed in the comment above them, harmonics 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13 and 15. Sjip.cpp:161 multiplies the sum by 10.
